maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is mainly hotel room, food and beverage income from guests at 29 owned hotels, not repair or replacement work.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by leisure and business travelers and groups staying at its Hilton, Marriott and Hyatt-branded hotels and resorts.

serial_acquirer.reason: Lodging REIT with 29 hotels that recycles capital and sells assets; growth is not from a steady stream of acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Hotel guests and groups can easily choose other hotels; no switching cost for travelers.
